think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented valid range. 2) Check whether any in-range numeric value is designated as a sentinel (e.g., -1, 0) that changes the knob’s meaning to a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just ‘more/less’. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
